scenario.title: Willowbrook's turnaround tier
scenario.setting: A veterinary radiologist at PawsDiagnostics whose assistant keeps referral instructions from dozens of partner clinics straight

items.text: PawsDiagnostics runs two reading queues: a stat queue with a 4-hour turnaround and a standard queue with a 24-hour turnaround.
Every partner clinic's referrals are read in the turnaround tier recorded for that clinic, and a tier only changes after written confirmation from the clinic.
Studies from sedated patients are always read ahead of non-sedated studies within the same tier.
Marta reads studies on weekday evenings, and her colleague Tomas covers weekends.
Willowbrook Animal Clinic's referrals are read in the standard 24-hour turnaround tier, and their studies arrive through the Willowbrook direct upload portal.
Willowbrook's radiograph studies are batched and read at the end of each day, matching their 24-hour turnaround tier.
Maple Ridge Veterinary Hospital signed on as a partner clinic at the start of July.
Maple Ridge's referrals are read in the stat 4-hour queue because they send mostly emergency orthopaedic cases.
Send each partner clinic its written reading-tier confirmation for the autumn schedule; for Willowbrook this means listing the tier their referrals are currently read under. Not done yet.
All Willowbrook uploads are collected through their direct portal link, and nothing from Willowbrook is accepted by email.
Cedar Lane Cat Clinic refers only dental radiographs, roughly four studies a month.
Willowbrook's results are included in the Wednesday morning summary report to the clinic, since the end-of-day readings roll into the next morning's summary.
Tomas is on holiday from 20 to 27 September, so Marta covers the weekend readings that week.
The new ultrasound machine was delivered and installed in the second reading room.
Pay the ultrasound service contract invoice of 1,850 to VetTech Services. Done on 28 September.
Cedar Lane's dental studies are read in the standard tier on weekday mornings.
Willowbrook's lead veterinarian is Dr. Harriet Cole, who signs all their referral forms.
Maple Ridge Veterinary Hospital now requires all imaging results to be delivered to them by 6 pm on the same day the study arrives.
Partner clinics are invoiced monthly with a flat per-clinic fee; there is no per-study billing.
Maple Ridge studies are read in the afternoon block so their results go out before the 6 pm same-day delivery deadline.
PawsDiagnostics is closed for staff training on Monday 2 November.
Willowbrook refers about six studies a month, mostly hips and spines.
